faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIMHANS Research Associate Grade III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 12th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate Grade III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in a relevant branch of Life Sciences, Social Sciences, or Public Health, or an MD/MS/MDS or equivalent postgraduate medical degree, or an MPH with Science background.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Research Associate Grade III position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate Grade III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000 per month, plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate Grade III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate Grade III position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the NIMHANS Research Associate Grade III recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis for the Research Associate Grade III position at NIMHANS.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIMHANS located?
faq.answer: NIMHANS is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560029.

faq.question: Q10. How should I send my application?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email. Ensure you attach all required documents and clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of your email.
